nodes.description: IERC20 token users stake into the contract; target of safeTransferFrom and safeTransfer calls.
IERC20 token used to pay out staking rewards; target of safeTransfer in getReward.
Total amount of staked tokens tracked internally, updated through SafeMath add/sub.
Timestamp when the current reward period ends; derived from block.timestamp.
Rate of reward distribution per second, computed with SafeMath div/mul.
Last timestamp at which reward accounting was refreshed.
Accumulated reward per token checkpoint updated by rewardPerToken().
Privileged address allowed to call notifyRewardAmount; owner controlled.
Mapping of user address to staked balance, mutated on stake/unstake.
Mapping of user address to last paid rewardPerToken checkpoint.
Mapping of user address to accrued but unpaid reward amount.
External caller address, used for stake/unstake/getReward authorization and balance keys.
Miner-controllable timestamp used in lastTimeRewardApplicable and notifyRewardAmount.
Public payable-less function that pulls stakeToken from msg.sender and credits _balances.
Public function that debits user balance and sends stakeToken back to msg.sender.
Public function that pays accrued rewardToken to msg.sender.
External function restricted to rewardDistribution that recomputes rewardRate using block.timestamp.
External convenience function calling unstake with full balance then getReward.
External onlyOwner function that transfers arbitrary token amounts to the owner.
External onlyOwner setter for the rewardDistribution address.
View function computing accumulated reward per staked token with SafeMath.
View function computing a user's accrued reward from balances and checkpoints.
View function returning min(block.timestamp, periodFinish).
External call stakeToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) which transfers control to an arbitrary token contract.
External call stakeToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount) executed after balance updates.
External call rewardToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, reward) executed after zeroing rewards mapping.
External call IERC20(token).safeTransfer(_msgSender(), amount) on an owner-supplied token address.
Amount argument supplied to stake(uint256).
Amount argument supplied to unstake(uint256).
Reward amount argument supplied to notifyRewardAmount(uint256).
New reward distribution address supplied to setRewardDistribution(address).
Arbitrary token address supplied to recoverExcessToken(address,uint256).
Arbitrary amount supplied to recoverExcessToken(address,uint256).

edges.reason: stake uses msg.sender as the balance key and token transfer origin.
msg.sender indexes the _balances mapping mutated in stake and unstake.
stake amount parameter flows into _totalSupply and _balances updates.
stake invokes the external safeTransferFrom before completing token bookkeeping.
stake_transferFrom operates on the stakeToken state variable.
unstake performs an external stakeToken transfer to msg.sender.
unstake_safeTransfer operates on the stakeToken state variable.
unstake amount parameter decreases _totalSupply and _balances.
getReward transfers rewardToken to msg.sender, which may re-enter.
getReward_safeTransfer operates on the rewardToken state variable.
recoverExcessToken performs an external transfer on an owner-supplied token.
Token address parameter determines the target of the recovery transfer.
Amount parameter determines the value moved by the recovery transfer.
notifyRewardAmount branches on block.timestamp and uses it to set periodFinish.
lastTimeRewardApplicable returns min(block.timestamp, periodFinish), timestamp dependent.
Reward argument is divided/multiplied with DURATION and existing rewardRate.
notifyRewardAmount recomputes rewardRate via SafeMath div/mul on user reward input.
notifyRewardAmount sets periodFinish = block.timestamp + DURATION.
notifyRewardAmount updates lastUpdateTime to the current block.timestamp.
lastTimeRewardApplicable reads periodFinish to bound time.
rewardPerToken accumulates into rewardPerTokenStored with mul/div arithmetic.
rewardPerTokenStored checkpoint is written into userRewardPerTokenPaid for the account.
rewardPerToken feeds the earned computation that updates the rewards mapping.
earned computes and writes the rewards mapping values.
getReward calls earned(msg.sender) to determine the payout.
stake's updateReward modifier recomputes earned(account), a re-entrant accounting path.
unstake's updateReward modifier recomputes earned(account) after external interaction patterns.
exit calls unstake with the caller's full balance.
exit calls getReward after unstaking.
getReward pays rewards to msg.sender and zeroes rewards[msg.sender].
notifyRewardAmount's onlyRewardDistribution modifier compares msg.sender to rewardDistribution.
recoverExcessToken's onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to _owner.
setRewardDistribution's onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to _owner.
New address parameter is written into the rewardDistribution state variable.
setRewardDistribution mutates the privileged rewardDistribution address.
rewardDistribution gates who may inject rewards via notifyRewardAmount.
stakeToken state variable is the receiver of the safeTransferFrom call in stake.
Callback from rewardToken transfer can re-enter reward accounting that reads/clears rewards mapping.
recoverExcessToken can move the rewardToken or stakeToken balance out of the contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists as input to stake and should be folded into that function node.
The amount parameter is only used inside unstake to reduce balances and totalSupply.
The reward parameter is exclusively consumed by notifyRewardAmount arithmetic.
The new distribution address parameter is only written by setRewardDistribution.
The token parameter directly selects the target of the recoverExcessToken external transfer.
The amount parameter directly sets the value of the recoverExcessToken external transfer.
